english.title: Trespass on premises with weapon of offence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being on premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), as a trespasser, after having entered as such, had with you a weapon of offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1) and (3) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Tresmasu mewn eiddo gydag arf trosedd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau mewn eiddo, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..) fel tresmaswr, ac wedi i chi fynd i mewn fel y cyfryw, roedd gennych yn eich meddiant arf trosedd, sef**(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..) heb awdurdod cyfreithlon neu esgus rhesymol
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 8(1) a (3) Deddf Cyfraith Trosedd 1977.

other.powersofarrest: A constable in uniform may arrest without warrant anyone who is, or whom he, with reasonable cause, suspects to be guilty of an offence under this section (Subsection 8(4)).
other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
